name: stock-sst-turbulence-upwind-symmetry-remediation
objective: Test whether the persistent negative-k bounding caused by linear-upwind k and omega transport is responsible for the stationary zero-angle asymmetry, without changing the mesh, model, velocity scheme, boundary conditions, force definitions, gates, or source solution.
fixed_invariants: NASA TMR altered closed NACA 0012 897x257 mesh and every polyMesh file
all final U, p, k, omega, and nut fields copied from the completed stock-SST continuation
incompressible simpleFoam and packaged OpenFOAM v2512 kOmegaSST
alpha=0 deg, U=51.4815 m/s, nu=8.58e-6 m2/s, and freestream turbulence values
all gradients, laplacians, interpolation, wall distance, SIMPLE solvers, relaxation factors, and force definitions
all predeclared settling, trend, residual, symmetry, and NASA force-agreement tolerances

predeclared_outputs.settling: final-100 peak-to-peak <= max(0.001, 1% of absolute coefficient mean)
predeclared_outputs.trend: projected absolute change over 500 iterations within Cd 0.0002, Cl 0.004, and CmPitch 0.0002
predeclared_outputs.residuals: final-100 maximum initial residual <= 1e-5 for p, Ux, Uy, k, and omega
predeclared_outputs.zero_angle_symmetry: absolute mean Cl <= 0.004 and absolute mean quarter-chord CmPitch <= 0.0002
predeclared_outputs.force_agreement: absolute mean Cd minus NASA CFL3D SST Cd <= 0.0002
predeclared_outputs.negative_k: report occurrence count, worst minimum, and final minimum; no post-hoc acceptance tolerance
predeclared_outputs.primary_effect: final-100 mean force changes relative to the unchanged stock-SST continuation

decision_rule: The remediation is a viable stock-SST source only if provenance, invariant, runtime, model, finite-history, horizon, settling, trend, residual, and zero-angle symmetry gates all pass. NASA force agreement remains required for strict Gate 2. If symmetry does not recover, do not start exact SSTm and retain this as a failed mechanism test. No threshold may be loosened after observing results.
